help.text:
Usage: policy_sentry [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Policy Sentry is a tool for generating least-privilege IAM Policies.

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  create-template  Create write-policy YML template files
  initialize       Create a local datastore to store AWS IAM information.
  query            Allow users to query the IAM tables from command line
  write-policy     Write least-privilege IAM policies, restricting all actions
                   to resource ARNs.

--access-level.help: Filter according to CRUD levels. Acceptable values are read, write, list, tagging, permissions-management

--access-level-overrides-file.help: Path to access level overrides file, used to override the Access Levels per action provided by AWS docs

--audit-file.help: The file containing AWS actions to audit. Default path is $HOME/.policy_sentry/audit/permissions-access-level.txt.

--build.help: Build the IAM data file from the HTML files rather than copying the data file from the python package. Defaults to false

--condition.help: Supply a condition key to show a list of all IAM actions that support the condition key.

--crud.help: Use the CRUD functionality. Defaults to false

--fetch.help: Specify this flag to fetch the HTML Docs directly from the AWS website. This will be helpful if the docs in the Git repository are behind the live docs and you need to use the latest version of the docs right now.

--file.help: Supply the requestors IAM policy as a JSON file. Accepts relative path.

--fmt.help: Format output as YAML, JSON or CSV. Defaults to "json"

--input-dir.help: Relative path to Input directory that contains policy_sentry .yaml files (CRUD mode only)

--input-file.help: Path of the YAML File used for generating policies

--list-arn-types.help: Show the short names of ARN Types. If empty, this will show RAW ARNs only.

--minimize.help: Minimize the resulting statement with *safe* usage of wildcards to reduce policy length.

--minimize_length.help: Sets the minimum character length for minimization. Defaults to zero.

--name.help: Get details on a specific condition key. Leave this blank to get a list of all condition keys available to the service.

--output-dir.help: Relative path to directory to store AWS JSON policies

--output-file.help: Relative path to output file where we want to store policy_sentry YML files.

--print-policy.help: Print the example policy where actions are restricted to ARNs. Defaults to false.

--resource-type.help: Supply a resource type to show a list of all IAM actions that support the resource type.

--show.help: Show CRUD levels. Acceptable values are read, write, list, tagging, permissions-management

--template-type.help: Type of write_policy template to create - actions or CRUD. Case insensitive.
